remarks: Enjoy the Island Lifestyle at this beautiful, mint-condition home available for Lease (3 to 18 month terms considered) on spectacular Saugatuck Island. Scenic splendor surrounds you, and every day becomes a vacation when you reside in this sought-after water community where private beaches, marinas, sea breezes and a friendly atmosphere enhance the quality of life. Beautifully landscaped and set on a picturesque property with some water views, this Modern home is sparkling and ready for immediate enjoyment. Available either furnished OR unfurnished, this is the ideal home to spend up to one year in. The cathedral ceiling living room and dining room both have views of the attractive surroundings and are filled with light. The remodeled kitchen is immaculate, with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Step out onto the wraparound deck and enjoy a view of Long Island Sound, sunshine and fresh air. The family room has a fireplace and access to the patio and level backyard. Four bedrooms each have good closet space and there are two meticulous, updated full baths. Additional spaces include the full laundry room with sink, one car garage and a storage shed. There is an automatic generator. ADT security system. This home is available with OR without the tasteful furnishings shown in the photos, and is available for immediate occupancy. A term as short as 3 months or as long as 18 months will be considered.
